## How to play

Choose quick, balanced, or careful work at three stages of a sense–plan–act cycle. The strip plots estimated end-to-end latency. Dispatch only when the result can meet both the deadline and the task's minimum quality. Milliseconds and quality scores are toy values chosen for the game.

## The systems concept

For a physical system, correctness includes when a command reaches the actuator. More perception or planning can improve a proposal, but the added time can make the command stale. The full path from sensing through control consumes the deadline.
